name: Verify hover launcher fixes
command: bash scripts/test-sketchybar-menu-hover-launch.sh && bash -n home/.config/sketchybar/plugins/menu_bar_hover.sh && build_dir=$(mktemp -d) && /usr/bin/xcrun swiftc -warnings-as-errors home/.config/sketchybar/plugins/menu_bar_hover.swift -o "$build_dir/sketchybar-menu-hover" && "$build_dir/sketchybar-menu-hover" --self-test; result=$?; if [ -n "${build_dir:-}" ]; then rm -rf "$build_dir"; fi; exit "$result"
